title: icacorea loretensis
intro: Icacorea loretensis, commonly known as Loretto tree or Icacorea, is a plant species belonging to the Icacinaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Icacorea loretensis include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress and infection. The bioactive constituents of Icacorea loretensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
